round1_status.evidence: A sentence is drawn ('Your data in Granola is not deleted.') but it describes Granola's copy; it does not say Rakazo keeps meetings and to-dos. The three frames show retention only through the layout. See F2-GS-7-01.
Per-meeting Delete exists in the citation popover with a confirmation (cite-open.png, cite-confirm.png; decision D4). Bulk removal remains absent, see F2-GS-7-02.
Plan decides no confirmation: Disconnect is reversible and keeps all data, so one click is acceptable.
Plan Deliberate choices: a to-do from a disconnected source looks like any other.
After state is three labelled frames with their own sidebars (disc-after.png, disc-after-2.png).
The annotation sentence is gone from the Inbox frame.

findings.description: After Disconnect the only line says Granola's data is not deleted. Ethan's question is whether Rakazo keeps his meetings and to-dos. The plan reuses the existing sentence by choice, so the person who expects Disconnect to remove access is still surprised when the agent answers.
findings.expected: One sentence that says what Rakazo keeps, or a recorded decision to accept the surprise.
findings.actual: 'Your data in Granola is not deleted.' only (disc-after.png).
findings.suggested_fix: Reword once, for example 'Your meetings and to-dos in Rakazo are kept.', and quote it in the S6 PR; or record the decision.

findings.description: Delete is available per meeting only and only through a citation in an agent answer. A user who wants all stored meetings gone must ask about each meeting and delete one by one.
findings.expected: Plan states that bulk removal is out of scope, or offers account-level removal.
findings.suggested_fix: Record 'no bulk delete' as a decision in granola.md; revisit if users ask.

findings.description: Disconnect on the screen 2 key card returns to an empty card without the sentence 'Your data in Granola is not deleted.' that screen 6 shows after Disconnect.
findings.expected: Both screens show the same post-Disconnect card.
findings.actual: key-empty.png has no sentence; disc-after.png has it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the sentence to the 'empty after disconnect' variant or share one state.
